title: Third Law Definition
description: Essential Criteria: The response must accurately define the third law of thermodynamics.

title: Negative Temperature Explanation
description: Important Criteria: The explanation must clarify the concept of negative absolute temperature and its relation to population inversion.

title: Example of Negative Temperature
description: Essential Criteria: The response must provide a valid example of a system that can achieve negative temperature.

title: Classical Thermodynamics Discussion
description: Important Criteria: The discussion must explain why negative temperature is incompatible with classical thermodynamics.

title: Misinterpretation of Third Law
description: Pitfall Criteria: The response should avoid incorrectly stating that negative temperatures violate the third law of thermodynamics.
